answer: Each agent must post a bonded double-entry reserve ledger, so a sybil cluster inflates its proof-of-reserves only by locking real capital per identity, an oasis of verifiable solvency in a desert of fable claims. Cross-ledger reconciliation flags shared funding roots and circular transfers, pruning duplicate identities like dead willow branches from the audit trail. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
